title: Batteries
summary: Battery Banks store spare daytime power and carry the colony through the night.
text:
A **Battery Bank** soaks up any power you aren't using by day and pays it out when you're short, at night most of all. The 🔋 readout shows how full your batteries are.

Two rules worth knowing:

- Batteries cover everything **except** Mining Depots and Matter Printers, which only ever run on power being made right now
- Batteries only fill if you make more than you use: a colony that's short by day goes into the night empty

If the battery runs dry at night, the colony browns out: the least important buildings go dark first, and in a bad brownout the cryo bank goes short.

More batteries hold more. The research Deep-Cycle Cells makes every battery hold half as much again.
